Name: Hamutal, Mother of Jehoahaz and Zedekiah
Summary: Hamutal, daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah, was the mother of two kings: Jehoahaz, deposed after three months, and Zedekiah, Judah's last king.
RelatedPeople: Jehoahaz, King of Judah; Zedekiah, King of Judah; Jeremiah, Father of Hamutal
LifeLesson: One mother bore both a three-month king and the last king of Judah.
